svg.title: Moving-row and grid-integral recovery. Retain the finite regulator row, mesh, period and rounding cells in the source record. Write KZ m for its lifted scalar reading; then KZ m(o) = Km(o) for every retained grid tuple. Consequently its joint moving limit and every selected violation of a uniform compact bound are the identical scalar statements after recovery. A fixed compact profile support lies inside a compact neighborhood of the allowed open region. For sufficiently fine meshes, all rounded points relevant to its nonzero values lie in that neighborhood. The moving-limit bound therefore gives some finite M with
